contract: docs/design/mood-log-design-system.md; visual scope: the public Home entry screen and the initial Wear OS check-in screen, including responsive fit and visual hierarchy

accessibility.evidence: Chrome accessibility snapshot exposes named headings, links, logo images, and a labelled theme toggle. Keyboard Tab reaches the toggle with a 2 px magenta focus outline. Header touch targets measured 44x44 px or larger. Physical VoiceOver and TalkBack validation remains outstanding.

responsive.evidence: Rendered at 320x640, 390x844, and 1440x900; document width matched viewport at both phone widths and there was no horizontal overflow at any tested width. The initial wearable screen rendered on the 384x384 round Wear OS 6/API 36 emulator and its content scrolls. Other watch sizes and physical devices remain unverified.

loading.reason: The reviewed scope is the static public Home entry screen and the initial wearable check-in screen; no records are loaded in either captured state.

empty.reason: The screenshots do not show a record list or history view.

error.reason: The captured public entry and initial watch screens do not display a service error; recovery flows are outside this visual review.

partial.reason: The captured screens contain no partially loaded records or reports.

success.reason: No mood check-in or pulse measurement was submitted during the visual review.

permission.reason: The watch measurement button was intentionally not activated; the review covers only the initial screen, with no sensor permission requested.

renderedEvidence.observation: Compact header and wrapped landing content fit a narrow phone viewport without horizontal overflow.
Phone entry screen shows the brand gradient, primary registration action, and responsive typography.
Desktop landing screen retains a centered content width and three-column feature layout without horizontal overflow.
Dark theme uses the charcoal canvas and preserves text and gradient CTA contrast; focus ring is visible on the theme control.
Wear OS 6 round emulator shows the compact mood check-in with distinct pulso and ánimo messaging; lower controls continue below the fold.
